bullets.text: Under project supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Under project supervision, ranked public news summaries for provided queries using TF-IDF similarity in scikit-learn and checked retrieved documents against a small judged query set.
Cleaned supplied publication metadata tables in pandas using provided steps, then plotted record counts with Matplotlib and inspected missing-value summaries with guidance.
